spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (मुणति)
To vow or promise.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
1 Shaved, bald, having no hair on the head.
2 Low, mean.
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 The head.
2 The forehead.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 A bald pate.
2 A barber.
3 The name of a Daitya or demon.
4 RĀHU, the personified ascending node.
5 The trunk of a lopped tree.
f. (-ण्डा)
Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
E.
मुडि to shave or cut, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A barber.
n. (-कं)
The head.
E.
मुडि to shave, aff. वुन्, or मुण्ड the head, कन् pleonasm.

n. (-नं)
Shaving, shearing, outing^1.
E.
मुडि to shave or cut, aff. ल्युट्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut tree.
E.
मुण्ड the head, and फल, fruit; the fruit being one step towards a human head, made by VIŚVĀMITRA, when he purposed establishing an opposition creation to that of BRAHMĀ.

f. (-ली)
1 A number of shaven heads.
2 A mass of troops of an inferior description.
E.
मुण्ड, and मण्डली a circle.

m. (-लिः)
A kind of grain or rice.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bald, shorn, shaven.
E.
मुण्ड bald, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Bald-pated, shaven-headed.
E.
मुण्डित, and शिरस् the head.

m. (-ण्डी)
A barber.
E.
मुण्ड shaving, aff. इनि.

f. (-री)
A plant, described as a creeper, bearing a red and yellow flower, and commonly called by the same name, Muṇḍīrī.
